//: NOTE: the system is designed to need NO composite indexes. The entries below are OPTIONAL performance indexes for the fan-out-on-READ scaling path described in ARCHITECTURE.md — create them only when that path is enabled. `npm run deploy:firebase` will attempt them and skip any it lacks IAM permission for.
